source: M107 (2026-10-01): the floor of an action whose every draft was refused or whose writer ran out of time. Each catalog operation has its plain clause (infinitive, then first-person past) in Spanish and English; the sentence is built only from the turn's facts: the operation, whether it was verified, failed or left uncertain, and the observed fields named below (the identity of what was acted on, a list read, a state read after). Read by the mind (baxy_mind.operation_floor) and by the App (Baxy.App.OperationFloor, embedded resource), so both say the same sentence. noSuccessFloor: a verified result whose answer is a value only its own final says (the clock, the PC's measurements) or that is not shown (a web search, owner's rule 2026-09-24). anonymous: the target is no name to say (a search query, a folder key). compositionFailures (live 2026-10-07, «⚠ (internal_code;retry_exhausted)» shown to the person): the line a composition that every draft failed leaves when no floor tells it, by what the turn was (a question still to ask, a result, anything else); the diagnostic code stays in the private log. mindStartup (r22, 2026-10-09): the App's line for a turn sent while the mind's model is not up, by the cause the mind reported (VRAM, RAM, the server's exit, time) or that it is still starting; it stands as the status line meanwhile and, like compositionFailures, is the App's line and not BAXY's reply. alreadyRunning (Estabilización F, tanda estab2 t2-c18 «…y abrí la aplicación «Microsoft Edge»» over an Edge that was already running): an open that found the app running says so (told), and one that made a new document in it says that. content (Estabilización F, estab2 t2-c07: a message sent told with a text the writer made up): a message sent or left written is said with the text its receipt verified, and with its channel; one whose receipt proves a text the floor cannot quote (contentProof: a hash that did not match, a text too long) is said without any. again (revisión F, H2): the floor's sentence when it would repeat the last answer word for word; the writer is never asked for a result the floor says. asked/cancelled (Estabilización M2, live recheck 2026-10-12: «nah» to a forget was told «He borrado de tu memoria tu bebida favorita.», and «¿…que borro…?»): the question that confirms a pending act and the sentence of that act cancelled, said whole from what the act names (the first of «by» whose value has a wording, else the empty key); a cancelled act is never told as made. told: the wording a verified receipt is said with, whole, picked by an observed field («by»); with «key», only when that observed flag is «is» (a state already there); without it, always (Estabilización M2, a memory result: «Listo, me acuerdo: tu color favorito es el verde.», «Listo, lo olvidé.»). It may name observed fields ({value}); one it cannot fill falls back to the plain one. cancelledFloor.firstPartOf: the arguments named by their first part (a UIA label «Cotele!!!, Canal de voz, Choche» is the control «Cotele!!!»). variants: the clause (and its facts) a verified result takes by an observed field; a failure keeps the plain clause, since a state read beside it is the one that held. attempted (M116): what a failed or uncertain step attempted, said in words (the client, the side) beside its target, with its text quoted (content keys); a quiet read that failed is told by the effects it left undone (notDone).

computerUse.source: Live 2026-10-07 (v2-v9, v2-u7, v2-n5): the floor of a computer-use mission, read by the mind (cu_finals.floor_sentence) and by the App's twin (OperationFloor.ComputerUse). A place reached is said as the window writes it; a mission not done says what was not reached and the typed cause.

placeToggle.source: Encargo S de estabilización (banco e1/e2, u1 y y8: «Tu biblioteca» de un reproductor es un panel que la ventana abre con «Abre Tu biblioteca» y cierra con «Comprimir Tu biblioteca»). El botón propio de un lugar se llama como el lugar, solo o tras uno de estos verbos (plegados, con su espacio): «opening» abre su panel (mientras se ve, el lugar está cerrado), «leadsTo» sólo lleva a él (un clic en él va al lugar, pero que siga a la vista no dice nada: revisión S, H4), «closing» lo cierra, y sólo existe mientras el lugar está abierto. Lo leen la App (ComputerUseSuccessCheck: el lugar está abierto o cerrado por su botón propio; ALastClickOpened y ClickedPlaceLeftTreeAsIs quitan el verbo de apertura) y la mente (cu_lookup.own_place_button: un lugar con botón propio nunca se busca en el buscador del contenido). Un botón que sólo se llama como el lugar no es el suyo (Discord: «Cotele» un servidor y una tarjeta de actividad). «examples» ata a los dos lectores.

overwrite.source: Goal v3 point 2 (cu-v3 r2 diag_tipos §2.B.6): a click (or Enter/Space on the focused button) that confirms writing over a file that already exists. Read by the App (OperationFloor.OverwriteConfirm/OverwriteWarning, ComputerUseMission.Overwrites/KeyOverwrites) over folded text: lower case, no accents. RiskPolicy confirms the click or the key (consequence overwrite).
overwrite.confirmSource: A short label (six words or fewer: a button, not a sentence) that starts by answering yes or by replacing: «Sí», «Sí, reemplazar», «Reemplazar el archivo en el destino», «Replace the file in the destination», «Yes to all». Never alone: the view must also warn (warning).

contentErasing.source: Goal v3 ventana-misión (review, finding 3): a click on a command that selects all of a document, cuts, erases, pastes, replaces or undoes. Read by the App (OperationFloor.ContentErasingCommand, ComputerUseMissionWindow.ForeignDocumentAct) over a folded label: lower case, no accents. Never done on the content of a document the mission neither opened nor created and the request does not name.
contentErasing.label: ^(?:seleccionar\s+todo|select\s+all|cortar|cut|borrar|eliminar|suprimir|delete|clear|erase|pegar|paste|reemplazar|replace|deshacer|undo)\b\S*(?:\s+\S+){0,3}$
contentErasing.commandKindsSource: Ronda 24 (pasada r23 t-form-2): the label is judged only on a control that executes something; a field (Edit, ComboBox, Spinner, Text: the «Reemplazar» box of a find dialog) is never an order. A click whose control the view does not name is judged by its label.
contentErasing.choosingKindsSource: Revisión 2 de r24 (B3): a verified click on a control that chooses or navigates (a tab, a row of a list, a node of a tree, a cell) on a window where the mission created a document retires that document (ComputerUseMissionWindow.NoteCreatedDocument): the window may now show the person's page of the same name («Sin título» of another section). Never a command.
contentErasing.requestedSource: Ronda 24 (pasada r23 t-form-2: «reemplazá casa por hogar en el bloc de notas» refused «Reemplazar todo»): a command of the class the request itself names (a verb of its folded objective, «request»: the verb only, imperative, voseo, infinitive or gerund with its pronouns, never a noun of its root such as «borrador», «corte», «pegatina» or «eliminatoria»; revisión 1 de r24, B3) may be pressed on the window of the named application the mission is tied to, while it shows the document it showed when the mission took it. «label»: the class's commands, folded.
contentErasing.commandPositionSource: Revisión 3 de r24 (B2: «escribe una nota corta en el bloc de notas» let «Cortar» through, «write a clear note in notepad» «Delete» and «Clear all», «anota en el bloc de notas que manana hay pega» «Pegar»): a word of «request» is the verb that names the class only where an order stands, never as an adjective or a noun of the same spelling (corta, clear, pega, paste, cut). The folded objective before the word ends at «commandPosition» (the request's start, a punctuation mark, a link of orders such as y, luego, and, then, a courtesy or a modal such as por favor, puedes, can you, quiero, need to), or at it followed by «commandPlace»: the place the order happens in, whose words (but «placeFillers») are all words of the tied window's application or title («en el bloc de notas» on «pendientes - Bloc de notas»); any other word there is the start of another phrase («in notepad write down the hair cut»). Read by the App (ComputerUseMissionWindow.RequestedOnTiedDocument).
contentErasing.placeholderSource: Ronda 24 (pasada r23 v3-34): a window the mission's own opening of an application started is the mission's («created») only when its document's content is empty or a placeholder line («Haga clic para agregar texto»); one that already holds text restored the person's work («restored»): no text and nothing that replaces goes there. Folded; twin of the mind's _PLACEHOLDER_LINE.

searchField.source: Ronda 24b (banco r23 c6: «prueba BAXY C6» typed into Discord's «Buscar .wolfsoultm.4191» while «Mensaje @Ron92» stayed empty, and the Enter after it passed as sent). A field whose own Name says it looks a name up (a search or filter field, a quick switcher, a «go to» box), folded; never one whose Name says it is an address. Read by the mind (cu_fields._SEARCH_NAME, _ADDRESS_NAME) and by the App (OperationFloor.SearchFieldName, the typing receipt's «intoSearch»). Revisión 1 de r24b (B3): only an Edit or a ComboBox is a search by «name»; a Document is one only when its whole own name, folded and trimmed of a closing «:», «.» or «…», matches «label» (never «Búsqueda de empleo» or «Ir a la playa», a document's title): the mind's semantic.cu_semejanza.is_search_label and the App's OperationFloor.SearchLabelName.
searchField.name: \b(?:busc\w*|busqueda|search\w*|find|filtr\w*|filter\w*|a donde quieres ir|ir a|go to|jump to|quick switcher)\b
searchField.label: ^(?:buscar|busca|busqueda|buscar aqui|search|search here|find|filtrar|filtro|filter)$
searchField.composerSource: Revisión 2 de r24b (B1: «Enviar mensaje a #búsqueda-de-equipo», «Message #job-search», «Mensaje @Buscador99» were taken for searches and a message typed in them was refused as «left in the search»). «composer»: a field whose own Name says it is a message box (the mind's cu_fields._COMPOSER_NAME). «recipient»: a #channel or @person token in a name. In a name that is a message box once its recipients are read off, a search word that appears only inside a recipient does not make it a search (cu_fields._search_words, OperationFloor.SearchFieldName); «Buscar o empezar un chat nuevo» stays a search.

contentKeys.source: Ronda 21 (pasada r18 v3-59, v3-36): the keys of the closed repertoire (ProductCatalog, input.key.press) as the act alters a document's content or not. Read by the App (ComputerUseMissionWindow.ForeignDocumentAct: a key of «keeping» is never refused on a document the mission may not touch; a refused rule or learned key outside «altering» hands the step to the model) and by the mind (computer_use: over a view showing a document's content only a «keeping» key is a blind search shortcut; ctrl_k inserts a link in an editor, measured on t-menu-3). Only keys of the repertoire are listed (a test holds them against the catalog).
contentKeys.keepingSource: Moving through the content, copying, finding, opening a menu or a dialog, leaving: nothing of the document changes.
contentKeys.containerSource: Opening a new container or taking the keyboard to the window's bar in a browser (a new tab, the address bar). In an editor the same chords format the text (a hanging indent, an alignment): never exempt by themselves, they are judged by the control the keyboard is on (a read-only page is no content), and a rule's or a learned one refused hands the step to the model.
contentKeys.alteringSource: Selecting, erasing, replacing, pasting, undoing or writing at the caret or over a selection: a rule's or a learned key of these refused on a document the mission may not touch stops the mission as the model's does.
contentKeys.pasteSource: Ronda 24 (pasada r23 t-long-1: Ctrl+V accepted 84 ms after an application opened, the tab left with «0 caracteres», the sub-goal closed on the key's receipt). A key that puts what the clipboard holds where the keyboard is: its act proves the sub-goal (check atom stepDone) only when the look after it shows the focused field's or document's value changed from the look before the key, or, where the focus shows no value, the same window's signature changed. The clipboard itself is never read nor recorded.
contentKeys.copySource: Ronda 24: a key that puts the selection in the clipboard, which no look shows and BAXY never reads: the window keeping its signature after it is its nature, never «no effect» (a «copiá el resultado» closes on its own check, as before).
contentKeys.unseenEffectSource: Teclas sin efecto (r9), moved to data in review 4 of ronda 24: keys whose effect lands where the view's signature does not look (written text, the caret, the selection, the clipboard, a saved file, a submitted line). Measured on the Terminal's frozen view (14 controls, the console text no control's value): a typed command and its Enter keep the signature although the command ran, and so does an arrow that brings back the last command. A look that kept the signature (the step's «sameView») says nothing about them: the mind's blind-key refusal (key_without_effect) never reads it on them, and an act with an effect (acted_with_effect, ComputerUseSuccessCheck.ActedWithEffect) is denied to one only as «writtenEffect» says.
contentKeys.writtenEffectSource: Review 4 of ronda 24 (an Enter that ran «repetir el último comando» in the Terminal and its Ctrl+V were taken for keys without effect because the console is no control's value). Of «unseenEffect», the keys whose effect, where the signature does not look, lands on the written text (a submitted line, a character erased or put): one left the view as it was only when the first look after it kept the signature (sameView) and also read the same written text as the look before it (the App's «sameText»). Caret, selection, clipboard, save and undo keys land where no look reads (an undone stroke on a canvas): they are never «as it was».

computerUse.typedChordSource: Ronda 22 (pasada r18, t4-c13 «ponle negrita al texto que tengo seleccionado»): the model typed the text «Ctrl+B» over the person's selection twice. A text to type whose whole folded form is a key combination (a modifier, «+» or «-», a key) is never typed: the visible control that does it is pressed, or the catalog's key. Only a request that writes that very text (a verb of writing and the text in its words) types it. Read by cu_validate._checked_act.

alreadyThere.source: Live 2026-10-07 (v2-s12, v2-c17): Steam already on its library, the learned click on «BIBLIOTECA» only opened its menu and the page stayed as it was. Said when the last verified click was on the place's own name and the window's text stayed the same; never told as arrived.
alreadyThere.es: Parece que ya estabas en {place}, pero no pude confirmarlo en la pantalla
alreadyThere.en: It looks like you were already in {place}, but I couldn't confirm it on the screen

computerUse.loadingSource: Pasada v3 r9 (v3-43): «dime qué plan está activo» answered «Cargando», the progress bar of a page still loading. A screen value named as a loading indicator (folded) is no fact of the window. Pasada r15b (v3-16, v3-43): a ProgressBar so named («Ocupado» on an image editor still opening, «Cargando» on a page) marks a look that is not ready yet: the mission reads it again, bounded, before judging or deciding on it. Review of fable/cu-v3-carga-preguntas (finding 4): «ocupado» and «busy» name a loading indicator only on a ProgressBar («loadingBar», the App drops such a bar from what the final quotes); on any other control they are a fact (a calendar's «Mostrar como: Ocupado», a messenger's «Busy» status), so «loading» (any control) keeps only the names that always mean a wait.
computerUse.documentPartSource: Ronda 20 P1 (pasada r18, v3-11 t2: «escribe ahí» renamed the existing page «Sin título»): a text whose receipt says it went into a part of a document other than its body (the control that had the keyboard, «into») that the step did not choose («field») reached no sub-goal, and the final says where it went. Review of r20 P1 (finding 2): only a step written at the caret (no «field» nor «index»); one the provider delivered by its index to the field it chose went there, whatever had the keyboard. Finding 3: the negated forms «sin título», «no title», «without title» (like «untitled») name a whole document that has none, never its title part.

antecedentFailed.source: Ronda 20 P3 (pasada r18, v3-11 t2): «escribe ahí: comprar pan, leche y huevos» right after «en onenote crea una pagina nueva» was told as failed wrote the text into the title of a page that already existed. A place the person only points back to («ahí», «en ella», «there») whose request was told as failed is asked about, never acted on: the request before and this one quoted, and the window that failed result itself observed when it did, never one of a turn before (semantic.dialogue.DialogueState.antecedent_failed). Review 1: an «ahí» whose place the same message says (the application it frames or opens, a clause before it) is no pointer to the turn before, and «ahí va» is a filler.
antecedentFailed.es: No llegué a hacer {before}. ¿Hago {said} igual en {window}?
antecedentFailed.en: I didn't get to do {before}. Should I still do {said} in {window}?
antecedentFailed.esBare: No llegué a hacer {before}. ¿Hago {said} igual en la ventana que está abierta?
antecedentFailed.enBare: I didn't get to do {before}. Should I still do {said} in the window that is open?

alreadyChosen.source: Pasada v3 r9 (v3-13): the media player's theme was «Oscuro» before the mission touched it; the model said done and the final said «No pude». An option the goal names shown chosen while no act of the mission chose it is told as it already was, never as done nor as a failure.
alreadyChosen.openedSource: Encargo H1 (tandas fin1/fin2 t4-c04 t3): the mission launched the application only to find the option already chosen; what it did is said, and that the option was so (cu_finals.already_chosen_sentence).
alreadyChosen.enOpened: I opened {app} and {seen} was already chosen

seenNotDone.source: Falsos éxitos v3 M1 (v3-17, v3-35, v3-40): the model said done in a goal of doing something with nothing done, citing what the first look already showed or what BAXY itself had typed. Never told as done; with no act of its own the mission says so and quotes what shows.
seenNotDone.es: No pude hacerlo en {app}: no hice nada y ya se ve {seen}
seenNotDone.en: I couldn't do it in {app}: I did nothing and {seen} already shows
seenNotDone.esBare: No pude hacerlo: no hice nada y ya se ve {seen}
seenNotDone.enBare: I couldn't do it: I did nothing and {seen} already shows

evidence.source: Falsos éxitos v3 M1-M3 (cu-v3 r3a): the one judge of the model's done (ComputerUseSuccessCheck.EvidenceRefusal) and its mind mirror (cu_validate._checked_act), over folded goals (lower case, no accents). A goal that is neither a place («ir a X», placeGoal) nor a reading (readGoal, or a goal carrying a question) is a goal of doing something: the model's cited evidence proves it only after a verified act with an effect, when the first look did not show it already and it is no text BAXY typed this session. Opening the application is that act only for a goal of opening (openGoal). A search (searchGoal) is proved by a result line, never only by the box repeating the query. noResults: a line saying a search found nothing is no result. searchAddress (v3-59 r7): the folded address of a page of web search results, with or without its scheme (a Chromium address bar may show it without «https://»); a place typed into an address bar that left the window on such a page was searched, not reached (its title repeats the query).
evidence.undoingGoalSource: Revisión 1 de r24 (B1): «activá el wifi», the click on «Wi-Fi» left it off, and the done citing «Wi-Fi» passed as changed by its click. A control its own click changed is new only when it now shows the change the goal asks for: a switch off only in a goal that takes something off (this pattern over the folded goal), a switch on or an item selected in any other. Same pattern as the mind's semantic.cu_buscar._UNDOING_GOAL (test_cu_r24_llegada_por_el_acto).
evidence.productGoalSource: Ronda 24 (pasada r23 v3-33 «sacá una captura de pantalla completa»: the mode «Pantalla completa» chosen in its list was cited as done and «Nueva captura de pantalla» was never pressed). A goal of producing something (folded: a verb of making, taking or recording, then the product's noun, captured as group 1) is never done by an option the act chose (a list's entry, a radio button, a tab, a combo box's value): the option is how the product is made, not the product. The retry names the view's control that carries the product's noun. Revisión 2 de la ronda 24: the verb of making includes the imperative of tú («haz», «hazme»); the product is a new thing, so its noun comes bare or after an indefinite article («una», «otra», «a», «another»): after a definite article or a possessive («la foto», «the video», «mi foto») the object already exists and the goal changes it («hacé la foto en blanco y negro», «make the video 1080p», «take the photos tab»): it makes no product.
evidence.creatingSource: Lote r11 (v3-11): «en onenote crea una pagina nueva» pressed «Crear una nueva sección» and «Agregar página» again and again: four sections nobody asked for. A press on a command that creates (its folded name: a verb of creating and its object) is never one that creates a thing the creating goal does not name, and, once it brought something new, never pressed again (each press creates another) unless the goal says a quantity. Read by computer_use (_creation_refusal).
evidence.creatingKinSource: Review of finales-buscador (finding 1): the goal keeps the person's words («create a new folder») while the window speaks its own language («Nueva carpeta»). The words of one created thing in Spanish and English; the first of a group stands for all (five folded letters each, as _created_words cuts them).
evidence.untitledDocumentSource: Ronda 24 (pasada r23 v3-11: «Agregar página» made «Sin título - OneNote» and nothing recorded it). The words a window's title gives a document that has no name yet (its document part, folded words): marker words, never the name of an application. After a verified click on a command that creates, a title that turns into one of these that the window's first look did not show is a document the mission created (ComputerUseMissionWindow.NoteCreatedDocument; the mind reads it as the click's createdDocument, cu_creation._created_by_diff). Encargo EX: so is an untitled or default-named one (defaultDocument) after any click decided on a start page, whose title named no document.
evidence.defaultDocumentSource: Ronda 24b (banco r23 u5, n6: «Libro1 - Excel» en blanco ya delante y se pidió un libro en blanco). The name an editor gives a new document before it is saved (its title's document part, folded words): a document noun and a number, never the name of an application. With no content it is the new blank document asked for, already there (ComputerUseMissionWindow.BlankDocumentShown, the mind's _blank_document_shown).
evidence.contentCountSource: Ronda 24b, revisión 1 (B2: «Documento1 - Autorecuperado - Word» con 13 caracteres tomado por en blanco porque Word no expone el texto de su documento como value). The count an editor's status text gives of what its document holds (folded name of a Text or StatusBar: «21 caracteres.», «Mensaje de estado Documento1: 13 caracteres», «0 palabras»): a count above zero is content; zero proves the document empty when its text is not readable (ComputerUseMissionWindow.BlankDocumentShown, the mind's _blank_document_shown).
evidence.commitControlSource: Revisión 1 de la ronda 20 P4: «crea un evento nuevo» pulsó «Nuevo evento» y el foco quedó en el «Agregar un título» vacío de un formulario con «Guardar» y «Descartar»; la parte nueva por identidad lo daba por creado. Un botón (Button, SplitButton) con uno de estos nombres en la vista es un formulario que falta guardar o confirmar: lo que hace no existe todavía (_created_by_effect, _new_part_by_identity y su gemela ComputerUseSuccessCheck.NewPartByIdentity).
evidence.commandBoxSource: Lote r11 (v3-10): «search my onenote notebooks for receta» typed «receta» into the ribbon's «Búsqueda de Microsoft» (the box that finds the application's commands and help, «Tell me»), not into the search of the notes. A field whose own name (folded) is such a box is never the place of a search of content: another search field of the view is, or the model is told why. Read by computer_use (validate_decision, _search_affordance).
evidence.failureTextSource: Pasada v3 r9 (v3-11): «crea una página nueva» said done citing the warning «Ya existe una sección con ese nombre. Utilice otro nombre.»; a warning that something failed is never the proof of doing it (folded text).
evidence.noResultsSource: Ronda 20 P8 (v3-29): the character map's search for «copyright symbol» said «No hay caracteres disponibles» and the sub-goal closed on the echo of its box. Saying that none of a thing is available («no hay X disponibles», «ningún X disponible», «no X available», «0 X found») is a search that found nothing; «Hay 3 actualizaciones disponibles» is not.
evidence.queryFunctionWordsSource: Ronda 20 P8 (t-scroll-2): the words of a search query that say nothing of what is sought, left out when a result is matched by all the query's words in any order («omega mayúscula» found as «Letra griega mayúscula Omega»).
evidence.noticeTextSource: Ronda 22 (pasada r18, t4-c13): after the text «Ctrl+B» typed over a recovered document, the model cited «DOCUMENTO DE SOLO LECTURA» as the bold applied. A notice of the window's own state (read only, protected view, a recovered or unsaved file, a locked selection, a compatibility mode, a licence) proves no act of a goal: a piece of a citation that says one is never the proof (folded text). Read by ComputerUseSuccessCheck.EvidenceRefusal and its mind mirror cu_evidence._unrelated_evidence.
evidence.relevanceSource: Ronda 22 (pasada r18, t4-c06 «crea un blank workbook»: the gallery «Excel | Inicio | 1 | Nuevo | 2…» cited after a click on «Nuevo»; t4-c13: a read-only notice cited as the bold applied). The citation of a goal of doing something proves it only when one of its pieces new on screen (or the name of a control an act of the sub-goal chose, now selected or on) shares a word of the goal: three letters or more, cut to five letters, never one of relevanceFillers (verbs and words of every request), never the window's process name, an alias group of computerUse.evidenceAliases (or of creatingKin) standing for all its words. A number of the citation relates to a goal that holds a number. A piece that says a notice (noticeText) relates to nothing. «unrelated» only when every new piece is such a notice; revisión 3 de r22 (B1): any other new text proves by being new after the act, whatever its words (the song a click on «Siguiente» brought, the state a key left).
evidence.measuredValueSource: Ronda 22 (contracase cu-v3 cita partida, v3-16: «Restablecer | 90°» after a rotation): a value with its unit (degrees, a percentage, pixels, points, decibels, a size «1920 x 1080») newly on screen is the state an act changed, and relates to any goal; a bare number (a gallery's «1», «2») relates only to a goal that holds a number.
evidence.placePartsSource: Ronda 28 (tanda c27u2 t2-c03: «ir a pantalla» closed by the model citing «Pantalla de bloqueo», another page, because the two share a word). What splits a written name (a citation's piece, a window's title, folded) into the parts that each name one place: a breadcrumb's mark, punctuation, a dash between spaces and the words that join two names («Red e Internet > Wi-Fi», «Wikipedia, la enciclopedia libre», «Bluetooth y dispositivos»). A part is the place only whole (ComputerUseSuccessCheck.CitationOffThePlace): «Pantalla de bloqueo» has no part that is «pantalla».
evidence.numberKinSource: Revisión 2 de r22 (bloqueante 1: «calcula cuánto es siete por ocho» refused «La pantalla muestra 56»): a number said in words in the goal is a number, as a digit is («#», the first of the group). Folded, whole words cut to five letters as relevanceSource reads them; «uno», «una», «one» are left out on purpose (an article, a pronoun), and so is «ciento» (its five-letter cut «cient» is the start of other words).

unanswered.source: v3 r5a M3 (v3-43, v3-44): a mission that reached its place but whose question no fact of the window answers (the page still loading: «Cargando 0») was told by the generic floor as a list read («hay 3: «Opciones de energía»»), and three honest drafts («No pude ver qué plan… está cargando») died as asserted_failure. The floor says the place reached and the question unread; a draft that says it could not read or see the answer, without denying the arrival, is no failure told. readFailure/arrivalDenied: folded.
unanswered.es: Llegué a {place}, pero no pude leer en la pantalla la respuesta a {question}
unanswered.en: I got to {place}, but I couldn't read on the screen the answer to {question}

placeAlready.source: v3 punto 5 (live 2026-10-07 v2-s12, v2-c17): Steam already on its library. A mission that reached its one place on its first look, with no act of its own (at most opening the application), tells the person they are already there, confirmed by the check that held (mark:, control:X:current, title:). Review r10a finding 1: only when that check proves it by itself (weakTerms: the model's cited evidence, an alternative «|»; weakAtoms: an atom that marks an arrival by resemblance) and as planned (a term the plan's check lists, never one an alias renamed), and only in a window that was already open (every app.open reused one: alreadyRunning). Opened by BAXY with a strong check it is the place reached; otherwise «placeSeems».

placeSeems.source: Review r10a finding 1: a mission reached with no act of its own whose arrival no check of the window proved (the model's evidence, an alias, a resemblance): told as what it seems, never as arrived nor as confirmed «already there». A reached mission is no failure, so the hedge carries no «no pude» (the App's reversed_result). esAlready/enAlready: the window was already open; es/en: BAXY opened the application.
placeSeems.enAlready: It looks like you were already in {place}

searchOpened.source: Ronda 24b (banco r23 x7, «Listo, estoy en «search»»): an arrival only a focused field proved (check atom focus:, weakAtoms of placeAlready) shows a cursor in a box, never a place reached: the final says the search opened and the field the cursor is in, as the window names it (observed focusedField); without a name, only that the search opened. Read by cu_finals._place_said and its twin OperationFloor.PlaceSaid.
searchOpened.es: Listo, se abrió la búsqueda y el cursor está en {field}
searchOpened.en: Done, the search is open and the cursor is in {field}
searchOpened.clauseSource: Review 1 of r24b (B1): in a chain the part a focused field proved is told among the others with these clauses (cu_finals._parts_final, OperationFloor.Parts), never with parts.lastPlace («ya estoy en «search»»).
searchOpened.esClause: se abrió la búsqueda, con el cursor en {field}
searchOpened.enClause: the search is open, with the cursor in {field}

evidenceAliases.source: Ronda 22: the words of one thing or one effect in Spanish and English (the person says «blank workbook», the window «Libro en blanco»; «negrita» is «Bold»). Folded, cut to five letters by the reader; the first of a group stands for all.

weakDone.source: Ronda 22 (pasada r18, t3-c18 t2, t3-c19 t3, t4-c06): a reached mission whose arrival only the model's own citation or a resemblance proved (weakTerms, weakAtoms, an alternative «|»: the same as semantic.claims.weak_proof) was told «Listo, lo hice en X». The floor then counts the verified acts besides opening the application and says the screen does not show the result; never «Listo». No «no pude»: a reached mission is no failure (the App's reversed_result). A mission with no term at all keeps its final. Read by cu_finals.floor_sentence and its twin OperationFloor.ComputerUse. Revisión 1 de r22 (hallazgo d): the sentence is the template the composer publishes after a draft dies on unbacked_act (semantic.claims.template_suffices), so it passes the book of acts (llm._claims_defect): no act told in the first-person past whose object is the count («Hice 2 pasos» read «2» as a thing done that only the screen shows; «took» is no lemma of the book), only the count of steps in the present, said in words (countWords; past the list, countMany): a figure is a value nothing on screen showed (ungrounded_word), the words are BAXY's own vocabulary (computer_use_words.v1.json).
weakDone.es: Llevo {count} pasos en {app}, pero la pantalla todavía no muestra que haya quedado hecho
weakDone.esOne: Llevo un paso en {app}, pero la pantalla todavía no muestra que haya quedado hecho

limits.source: Estabilización L (dueño 2026-10-10, límite de partida: lo que depende de hardware que el equipo no tiene; live n5: «Wi-Fi» en un equipo sin adaptador, dicho con una causa falsa). Un sub-objetivo que va al lugar de un dispositivo o lo cambia (deviceGoal, plegado; el nombre del dispositivo entero: «Bluetooth y dispositivos» existe sin radio) lleva steps[].requires (semantic.limits). La App lo lee con la operación «read» antes de mirar y, si responde un código de «absent», para con computer_use_limit_device sin actuar. El suelo (computer_use.device_final) lo dice con lo que hizo antes: «reached» si llegó a un lugar, «bare» si no. Ronda L2 (revisión de L: H2, H3, H5, H1, H8d): los demás límites se leen sobre el ACTO de cada sub-objetivo (kinds: «act», anclado al comienzo de una cláusula de acto, semantic.drag.act_clauses: sin lo dictado, citado ni buscado; «except» sobre el pedido entero) y marcan steps[].limit: la App hace los sub-objetivos anteriores y para al llegar sin mirar ni actuar (computer_use_limit_<kind>). Una lista que no acaba tras longListScrolls desplazamientos de rueda que la movieron es «limit:long_list». El suelo (cu_finals.limit_final) dice lo que hizo antes (reached, already, typed, did) y el límite (after/afterDevice, o head/bare sin nada hecho); stopped es la cadena que agotó pasos o tiempo. whichWindowOrder: «guarda esto» desnudo (o el guardar-como de missions.saved_on_screen_check) sin aplicación ni ventana, preguntado con whichWindow sólo si el turno no eligió una ruta tipada (__main__._asks_which_window); la respuesta que nombra la ventana sigue el pedido.

It carries nothing of the pages, so it is judged by the general veto and not by the search report's (which wants each sentence grounded in them), and it shows no search (owner's rule 2026-09-24: «Lo busqué» died there). heldFact.source: Ronda 24 (r23 t4-c04 «joder que te he dicho brillo no volumen»: three drafts vetoed, the turn went back to the decider and asked «¿Qué brillo quieres que tenga el volumen?»; r23 t2-c04 #3 «regresala como estaba» after a turn that only asked): when no draft can word a correction that already holds (alreadyHolds, by its kind) or an undo whose antecedent changed nothing (undoNothing), the final is the state's own fact, filled with what the state verified; never a question nor a turn decided again. Revisión 2: a held target may hold because nothing changed (r23 t4-c04 #1 «El brillo ya estaba al 40.», observed.changed false), so its sentence claims no change: what the last final was about and what was never touched. Read by the mind (llm._held_fact_final, the composer's last resort). Encargo TZ-CAL (tandas n1, n2, z2 t3-c18 t3): a held state, what a mission read on the screen, is said with its sentence first, never drafted (turn_followups._correction_already_held). Encargo TZ-HOLD (tanda z6 t4-c01 t4 «no po, en spotify te dije, no en youtube» with Spotify verified playing: the draft «Ya está reproduciendo … en Spotify» died as effect_claim and its retry «Eso es incorrecto, no estoy reproduciendo en Spotify.» was published): every held effect (playing, provider, state, target; all but a count of items told) is said with its sentence first, never drafted; a kind may list its sentences, the fullest first, and the first whose facts the state carries is said. Encargo H1 (tandas fin1/fin2 t2-c04 t3): undoUnapplied is the whole answer to an undo right after BAXY told the change did not happen (llm_chat, semantic.dialogue.undo_with_nothing_changed): no change of BAXY's to put back, never how the screen is now.

A thing BAXY's own store makes that applications also make (decider made_in_applications), made beside an application the request or the conversation is in, is told as made in the store, not in that application: the store travels in the situation («madeIn») and this sentence closes the final when the writer did not say the store (__main__._told_where_it_was_made, semantic.missions.made_beside_an_application). administratorAsked.source: cu-v3-elevacion (r9 v3-23, v3-65, live 2026-10-08): app.open starts an application with the person's own rights (forControl), so a console opened in one turn is one the next turn can read and press; a request that asks for administrator rights keeps the shell's path. Read by the App (OperationFloor.AdministratorAsked) on the folded request, whole words. Review of cu-v3-elevacion (finding 3): «elevado/elevada/elevated» only bound to what is raised (a console, a window, a mode, rights), never alone: «un consumo elevado» or «whether CPU is elevated» asks for no rights.

failureFamilies.source: Ronda 19 (uso real r17 t3-c07: message.recipient.resolve failed with discord_client_not_running and the floor said «No pude enviar el mensaje a «ron92».», with no cause): the mind's last sentence for a step that failed while others waited on it (a mission's failed reason, or a read that left effects undone) says the cause of its code's family, so it is never left without one. By family, never by code; an uncertain step keeps its own «pero no pude confirmar». Read by the mind only (operation_floor.with_family_cause): the App's twin floor keeps its plain clause. Revisión r19 (bloqueante 4): a family is the whole last words of the code (code, or _code at its end), naming the thing that failed, so the cause is said of it: «spotify_exact_play_control_not_found» over a play the song was found for, or «shell_command_directory_not_found» over a command, say no cause, never «porque no se encontró» of the act's object.
